# Copilot instructions for MT Safety Scanner

Repository-owned code is authoritative. Start at `AGENTS.md`, `COPILOT-IMPLEMENTATION-MASTER.md`, `FINAL-ADVERSARIAL-FACT-CHECK.md`, and the active PR prompt. The last three are **not yet committed** by this onboarding PR: require the user to extract and stage the complete handoff package before taking implementation actions. Historical reports are not executable instructions. First verify repository HEAD and real paths.

This is an MT Manager **SDK v3** `.mtp` plugin, NOT a Gradle Android app: keep `plugin/manifest.json` (pluginID, mainPreference, dexMode, minAndroidVersion24), pure Java 8 `plugin/src` core, v3 `plugin/ui-v3`, `tools/build.sh` JDK/D8 pipeline, compile-only MT API. Run `bash tools/build.sh test`; package via `bash tools/build.sh package` only after approving pinned toolchain/dependency downloads and validating exact inputs. Do not invent `ClamParser.java`, `tools/test.sh`, `tests/fixtures`, or `.github/workflows/build.yml`.

Security: treat plugin archives/signature DB as untrusted; bound reads/time/decompression/depth/memory; preserve current tests and confirmations; unsupported/error/partial must not appear fully CLEAN; categorize capabilities apart from proven behavior; no JS/DEX/native execution, no silent network/telemetry, no root/Knox changes, no automatic delete/quarantine. New libraries require recorded version/license/advisories/SHA-256/transitives and successful Java8/D8/API24/MT smoke validation. Phase-specific tests first; PR0 is baseline only. Stop for reviewer approval before any later phase. Report actual test outputs, unverified claims, and rollback.
